mark_scheme.criterion: rate of change of velocity (accept change in velocity per unit time / change in velocity divided by time taken)

hints: State what physical quantity changes and what it is divided by.
Use the exact syllabus term: rate of change of velocity.
solution: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity.
teacher_walkthrough: The controlled definition for Cambridge 9702 is 'rate of change of velocity'.
Do not accept 'rate of change of speed' because acceleration is a vector quantity.
